items.condition: The reported energies do not correspond to the supplied 72-atom anionic complex or use incorrect state charge/multiplicity.
A numerical gap is reported although either state lacks stationary-point/frequency validation or failed convergence is concealed.
The gap mixes electronic and Gibbs energies, inconsistent solvent/thermal models, or states with undocumented unit conversion.
The submission asserts proof of room-temperature kinetics or the complete radical mechanism from the two-state calculation alone.
